notes.title: Update Notice 0821
notes.content: [h1]Update Notice 0821[/h1][p] [/p][p]PS controller support is now available.[/p][p]New status effects have been added, and updates have been implemented based on these.[/p][p]Attacking monsters with a torch will now set them on fire.[/p][p]Fixed the damage caused by burning in certain situations.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45616778/df545336f50dde687cff8c1e23dcc68765cff52b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45616778/56f41823c81c0f443c2c97bcb5f2795c0101010e.png"][/img][/p][h3]Language[/h3][p]A pop-up for quick language selection is now provided when entering the game for the first time. (You can still change the language version at any time via the settings options.)[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][p]1. Updated the descriptions of some items to more clearly show their effects.[/p][p]2. Fixed an issue where the Defense stat was displaying incorrectly.[/p][p]3. Fixed an issue related to Respawn Points.[/p][p]4. To address the issue of small animals getting lost, we have equipped them with a collective GPS tracking system. They will no longer wander off easily.[/p][p]5. The Guardians have given the island's monsters an ideological education; they will no longer sleep in the mines.[/p][p]6. The Seed Merchant has imported healthier seeds. Our fruits and vegetables now provide higher Satiety and Hydration.[/p]

notes.title: [August 18 Update Notice]
notes.content:
[h1][b]\[August 18 Update Notice][/b][/h1][h3][b]Thank you for your support and understanding. This update includes:[/b][/h3][p] [/p][h3]1. Gamepad controller support (Button mapping not yet visible in settings - remapping coming later)[/h3][p]Y = Menu[/p][p]A = Confirm/Attack[/p][p]B = Back/Cancel/Switch building forms (only for structures with multiple forms, e.g. wall)[/p][p]Press and hold B = Open buildable forms menu (only for structures with multiple forms, e.g. wall)[/p][p]X = Interact/Item Info[/p][p]D-pad/Stick = Walk (Hold R2 to run)[/p][p]L1 = Select left quickslot / Switch[/p][p]R1 = Select right quickslot / Switch[/p][p]L2 = Dodge Roll[/p][p]R2 = Sprint[/p][p] [/p][h3]2. Bug Fixes[/h3][p](1) Fixed abnormal running behavior with gamepads[/p][p](2) Fixed text display errors[/p][p](3) Other miscellaneous bugs[/p][p] [/p][h3]3.New[/h3][p](1) Lava Burn Status: Upon entering the lava in a volcanic map, you will enter a Burn status, continuously losing HP.[/p][p] [/p][p]Note: Prolonged alt-tabbing may cause abnormalities. Restart the game if this occurs. This is an engine limitation we're actively resolving. Thank you for your patience.[/p][p]
[/p]

tags.feature: 1. Gamepad controller support (Button mapping not yet visible in settings - remapping coming later)

tags.bug: (1) Fixed abnormal running behavior with gamepads

tags.feature: (1) Lava Burn Status: Upon entering the lava in a volcanic map, you will enter a Burn status, continuously losing HP.

notes.title: "Sunshine Story" is Finally Here!
notes.content: [h1][b]"Sunshine Story" is Finally Here![/b][/h1][p]Dear players, thank you for your patience! The gates of the Sunshine Islands will soon open to everyone. We look forward to meeting you! ^u^[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]\[To All Players: Heartfelt Thanks and Commitment][/b][/h3][p]You can share feedback on all official platforms (Discord, QQ groups, official website \[in preparation...]). We will carefully review every message and regularly summarize feedback for you.[/p][p]We extend our deepest gratitude to everyone who has supported Sunshine Story! Every word of encouragement and every valuable critique guides our efforts.[/p][p]We know the game still has room for improvement. August 15 is not the end—it’s a new beginning![/p][p] [/p][h3][b]\[We promise][/b][/h3][p]Continuously optimize the game experience and resolve issues.[/p][p]Keep updating with exciting new features, gameplay, and content![/p][p] [/p][h3][b]\[Sneak Peek! Upcoming Features][/b][/h3][p]To fuel your excitement for the Sunshine Islands’ future, we’re thrilled to share two new features in development! They aim to make island exploration more convenient and delightful:[/p][p]Roam Freely! New "Island Vehicle System"![/p][p]Navigate your personalized small boat and freely traverse the scattered azure waters between the Sunshine Islands![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45616778/38a9d562ffe3498264c9cb8fd825f6bf39d13684.png"][/img][/p][p]Customizable minecart rails will deliver roller coaster-like thrilling high-speed smooth rides – the ultimate solution for planning efficient routes![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45616778/7a6eb468322749c1c39f294ba1dee48a424c0319.png"][/img] [/p][p]Surprises Await! "Random Treasure Chests"![/p][p]Exploring just got more fun! Mysterious randomly spawning chests will appear across the islands—in forests, beaches, and even volcano summits![/p][p] [/p][p]These fun and practical features are just the beginning! We’re committed to growing the Sunshine Islands’ world. Stay tuned![/p][p] [/p][p]Let's embark together on this pastoral adventure filled with limitless possibilities![/p]

tags.feature: Navigate your personalized small boat and freely traverse the scattered azure waters between the Sunshine Islands!

Exploring just got more fun! Mysterious randomly spawning chests will appear across the islands—in forests, beaches, and even volcano summits!
